definitions.explanation: Describes a person or figure that is attractively tall and thin, with an elegant, well-proportioned build.
Describes an action that proceeds smoothly and without difficulty or obstruction.

examples.japanese: すらっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧だ。
すらっと⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すらっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すらっと⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧こない。
examples.english: The name doesn't come to me smoothly.

examples.english: He answered the question smoothly, impressing those around him.

notes:
An onomatopoeic adverb describing either a slim, elegant physical form or a smooth, effortless manner of doing something. The core image is of something long, straight, and unobstructed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すらっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧: slender figure
- すらっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧: slender legs
- すらっと⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: tall and slim
- すらっと⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: stretched out gracefully
- すらっと⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer smoothly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すらり→すらり：20744_surari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: tall and slender — nearly synonymous; slightly more literary
- ⟦ほっそり→ほっそり：29039_hossori⟧: slim, thin — focuses on thinness without implying height; can suggest fragility
- ⟦スリム→スリム：21695_surimu⟧: slim — loanword; more casual and commonly used for body shape or design

USAGE:
Most commonly used with ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ to modify nouns (すらっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧). The physical appearance sense is much more frequent than the smooth-action sense. Always carries a positive, admiring connotation when describing physical appearance.
